worldcombat.skill.leer.summary: Narrow your eyes and rake a sharp glare into a fan in front of you, making the foes it sweeps tighten up and lose Defense; the glare must be seen, so cover blocks it. Sweep covers wide, Focus narrows to a beam for a deeper drop.
worldcombat.skill.leer.use.0: Hold a line of attackers back when they charge in a row
worldcombat.skill.leer.use.1: Open a gap for an ally's physical attacks
worldcombat.skill.leer.use.2: Strip Defense from a cluster in the open
worldcombat.skill.leer.description.0: Swept targets lose %1$s Defense stage(s) and stay cowed for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.leer.description.1: Glare length %1$s with a %2$s degree fan. Line of sight is required; anyone behind cover is missed.
worldcombat.skill.leer.description.2: Windup %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. Centred on you and thrown forward, never behind.
worldcombat.skill.leer.focus.off: Sweep: wide angle, only 1 stage, quick windup.
worldcombat.skill.leer.focus.on: Focus: a narrow beam for 2 stages, but slower windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.leer.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
When on, narrows the sweep into a beam: only the small wedge ahead, but 2 Defense stages; off keeps the wide fan, 1 stage, and a faster windup.
worldcombat.skill.leer.preference.ai.max: The companion only leers while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it close, larger presses sooner.
worldcombat.skill.leer.preference.ai.min: The companion only leers when at least this many visible non-friendly bodies stand in the fan toward the target, so the sweep is not wasted; 1 means leer at the first one.
worldcombat.skill.leer.preference.ai.lea: When on, the companion may leave its post to leer under a Hold order.
